technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Stream as the binding model for module integration.
Leverage existing Hadoop and Kafka client libraries for sink/source implementations.
Adopt JUnit 5 and Mockito for unit testing shell commands in isolation.
Use Spring Data JPA for composed job repository options.
Integrate XD-style module binding using Spring Expression Language (SpEL).
Migrate JDBC and Kafka modules to Spring Cloud Stream compatible format.
assumptions: Developers are already familiar with Spring Cloud Stream and XD architecture.
Hadoop and Kafka environments are available for integration testing.
Existing test infrastructure can be extended for shell command testing.
Composed job repository will use a relational database backend.
Module migration from XD to s-c-s follows standard Spring Cloud Stream patterns.
All modules will be implemented as Spring Boot applications.

activities.activity_description: Implement and register an HDFS sink module in the Spring Cloud Stream module registry for writing data to Hadoop.
Implement shell commands to interact with the Hadoop file system for querying and management.
Research and prototype repository options for storing and retrieving composed job definitions.
Implement orchestration logic to execute composed jobs as a single workflow.

activities.activity_name: Add Test Coverage for Shell Commands
activities.activity_description: Write isolated unit tests for shell commands without requiring full stream deployment.

activities.activity_name: Support XD-like Module Binding via Expressions
activities.activity_description: Enable Spring Cloud Stream modules to bind incoming messages using expressions or similar mechanisms.

activities.activity_name: Move JDBC Module to s-c-s Repo
activities.activity_description: Migrate the JDBC module from XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository as a sink.

activities.activity_name: Move Kafka Module to s-c-s Repo
activities.activity_description: Migrate the Kafka module from XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository as a source.
